[[Sujun]] is the initial trainer for [[Ranger]]s at the [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. In his spare time he collects gold to save the endangered [[Blue Skale]], frees captured animals and attends peace rallies. His [[animal companion]] is a [[panda]] named [[Ling Wong]].

==Dialogue==
To non-rangers:
:''"Hello, there! Such a lovely day! You are not a Ranger, so I am unable to train you. Do not take it personally, though! You are a very special person no matter which profession you have chosen. We are all special in the eyes of the gods, you know."''
To Rangers:
:''"Well, well! A new student! It is wonderful to meet you. I am Sujun, and I will help to train you in the ways of the Ranger. Are you [[Cantha]]n? No matter, we are all special in the eyes of [[Gods of Tyria|the gods]]. Now, what would you like to discuss?"''
;Monastery Overlook
:''"Now is not the time to talk. Please concentrate on your studies."''
